protocol_methods.name: record_command
rules: Validate data policy and server task/scope; insert once under literal key namespace.
Same key/request digest/admission binding/journey returns unchanged existing command; divergence conflicts.
Initial absent journey revision 0; acknowledged insertion becomes 1. Record refs/metadata only.

protocol_methods.name: observe_command
rules: Never grants dispatch or discloses protected result payload; authorize scoped metadata access.

protocol_methods.name: observe_journey
rules: No business cursor/status; source-owned refs and result custody remain separately governed.

protocol_methods.name: begin_dispatch
rules: Only RECORDED with current validated authority/audit evidence, binding and request digest.
Atomic acknowledged CAS writes DISPATCH_FENCED and immutable dispatch_ref/fence_version before source I/O.
Commit uncertain or CAS conflict forbids source I/O. Evidence presence/type alone is not authorization.

protocol_methods.name: record_pre_dispatch_refusal
rules: Only RECORDED; after dispatch fence no event can be classified as pre-dispatch refusal.

protocol_methods.name: mark_uncertain
rules: DISPATCH_FENCED to UNCERTAIN; keep original key/ref/fence; no reset, release, retry or new source effect.

protocol_methods.name: record_verified_result

closed_arguments.wait_intents: tuple[WaitDescriptor] explicit; empty tuple means no new wait

rules: Validate exact original command/dispatch_ref/request digest and source proof, tenant/legal entity/task/principal/source contract, current read authority and data/currentness gates before every initial, lookup or duplicate call.

DISPATCH_FENCED or UNCERTAIN to RESPONSE_RECORDED records the first verified direct result or qualified receipt lookup. RESPONSE_RECORDED to itself accepts a qualified later lookup result under result_head_rules. No source event_ref or transport ACK is required or synthesized for this path.

QualifiedSourceRecoveryPort supplies verified lookup evidence through the trusted gateway command boundary under independent current source read authority; it never calls execute or allocates a new command key.

The exact observation/result-head refs, declared new wait_intents, outbox_intents and one journal revision update share one tenant transaction as atomic_method_entities specifies. Pending/refused is not business completion.

Before any write validate all WaitDescriptor/OutboxDescriptor bindings, existing source producer/correlation and registered target/protected custody. Divergent intents or invalid proof roll back the whole call; creation never reopens an existing wait/fence.

Exact current-head duplicate with identical causal intents returns unchanged without a new revision/wait/outbox. Adding intents to an old duplicate is not a head update and requires the explicitly separate preparation path.

Different later source revision needs a qualified authority-owned ordering witness binding current and candidate head to this original command. Same-revision divergence, older/incomparable revision, stale authority/currentness or absent witness refuses without replacing head or creating intents.
This method creates declared waits only; it does not silently settle an existing wait. Settlement follows the existing authenticated ingest wait_ref path or the published OP08 source flow.

technical_signature_extension.reason: DJ-F02: result-created waits must be represented in the atomic journal call

protocol_methods.name: ingest_verified_observation

closed_arguments.wait_intents: tuple[WaitDescriptor] explicit; empty tuple means no new wait

rules: Authenticate the actual source event_ref, registered producer/source/contract and exact original command/object/correlation under current read authority/data/currentness before dedup or apply. A point lookup has no manufactured event_ref and uses record_verified_result instead.

DISPATCH_FENCED or UNCERTAIN to RESPONSE_RECORDED supports an authenticated first callback even without a synchronous result. RESPONSE_RECORDED to itself applies a qualified newer event result under result_head_rules; preserve original command/fence/identity.

Exact event namespace/digest/command link replay with current access verification is unchanged, no new journal revision/wait/outbox and no reapplication of its result over a newer head. Same event identity with different digest/link conflicts or goes to qualified durable quarantine without overwriting accepted bytes.

For a new event, same-revision divergent result, older/incomparable revision, missing ordering witness or stale authority/currentness refuses; preserve the accepted head and waits/outbox. Quarantine is separately gated and never constitutes source effect or disclosure.

Inbox, append-only observation/result-head refs, declared new wait_intents, optional existing wait_ref update, outbox_intents and one journal revision share one tenant transaction as atomic_method_entities specifies.

wait_ref must exist in the same scope at transaction entry and have a qualified original-producer/correlation settlement mapping. It cannot be simultaneously created/reopened through wait_intents; technical timeout never supplies source settlement.
Broker ACK is eligible only after acknowledged apply commit, exact authenticated durable duplicate or qualified durable quarantine; no ACK on invalid/unpersisted evidence or unknown local commit.

technical_signature_extension.reason: DJ-F02: result-created waits must be represented in the atomic journal call

protocol_methods.name: record_wait
rules: Preserve existing ExternalWaitIntent fields; source deadline ref is not local invented deadline. Technical OPEN only.

protocol_methods.name: mark_wait_elapsed
rules: Require existing admitted operational_wakeup_at and trusted-clock observation; OPEN to ELAPSED.
No OP08 timed_out/completed/incident, negative decision or customer resolution inferred.

protocol_methods.name: enqueue_outbox
rules: Only existing registered target and authorized payload ref; stable identity/digest; no arbitrary channel/address.
Creation causally needed by result/inbox apply uses their same transaction; standalone call never claims source-fact atomicity.

protocol_methods.name: claim_outbox
rules: RECORDED to CLAIMED; expired CLAIMED may be claimed only if no delivery fence ever exists.
Increment technical fencing version and reject old workers; lease is coordination, not authorization.

protocol_methods.name: begin_outbox_delivery
rules: Current claim/version/CAS only; commit DELIVERY_FENCED with stable delivery_ref before transport.
Recheck target authorization/currentness after await; no external send with unknown local commit.

protocol_methods.name: record_outbox_ack
rules: Exact authenticated target/payload/delivery acknowledgement; FENCED/UNCERTAIN to ACK_RECORDED.
Transport acknowledgement is not delivery receipt/domain completion; those remain OP09/OP10 source results.

protocol_methods.name: mark_outbox_uncertain
rules: Keep fence/identity after failure/crash/timeout; no lease expiry resend/reset/release.

protocol_methods.name: recover

closed_arguments.limit: Strict positive operational int from bounded configuration; no default

rules: Returns reference-only reconciliation candidates and operational wait observations; does not contact source or dispatch.
Lookup/reconciliation is read-only using original command/key under source contract, fresh admission and retention/erasure gate.
No automatic redispatch even on not-found or expired lease; source contract must prove old attempt cannot commit later before any separately admitted change.

DJ-F01 transition matrix: record_verified_result and ingest_verified_observation each accept DISPATCH_FENCED/UNCERTAIN/RESPONSE_RECORDED; pending head -> newer lookup needs no invented event_ref; first callback before sync result applies via real inbox.

DJ-F01 identity/currentness cases: exact duplicate unchanged; divergent result/event conflict; older/incomparable/missing witness/stale proof do not replace head or mutate waits/outbox; concurrent callback+lookup CAS loser never execute.

DJ-F02 same-TX elements must resolve to closed method arguments and atomic_method_entities; new waits require wait_intents, continuation refs require declared outbox_intents; no hidden cursor/body TX.

DJ-F03 reply receives declared JournalBinding/OutboxSnapshot and existing VerifiedAuthority/VerifiedCurrentness; current acknowledged claim/fence/binding/lease checked before transport; ACK cannot stand in for DeliveryEvidenceReceipt.

result_head_rules.required_before_any_result: original immutable handle/request/dispatch fence, verified source contract/scope, current independent read authority and qualified data/currentness; no proof by object construction
result_head_rules.no_previous_head: first verified result from DISPATCH_FENCED or UNCERTAIN records RESPONSE_RECORDED; pending/refused remain source outcomes
result_head_rules.head_identity: original command/request binding plus exact source_revision_ref/source_receipt_ref/result_sha256 and qualified result/provenance linkage; a locally minted observation_ref is not a source event identity
result_head_rules.same_revision_same_result: unchanged existing head with identical causal intents; no additional wait/outbox/revision
result_head_rules.same_revision_divergent_result: conflict IDENTITY_CONFLICT; no overwrite or intent mutation
result_head_rules.different_revision: replace only if qualified source_revision_order_witness_ref proves candidate newer than current head for this command and candidate currentness remains valid
result_head_rules.older_incomparable_or_missing_witness: conflict PROOF_UNAVAILABLE; accepted head/waits/outbox unchanged; no numeric/lexical/clock/offset/local-CAS revision ordering
result_head_rules.stale_or_revoked_currentness: refuse before apply, duplicate acknowledgement or disclosure under existing bounded proof/binding/data refusal; no new result/intent
result_head_rules.known_event_replay_after_newer_head: only exact authenticated inbox identity/digest/link with current access proof may return unchanged/ACK eligible; never replace the newer head
result_head_rules.racing_sync_lookup_and_callback: one CAS winner, loser authenticated rereads and revalidates only deterministic local merge; never another source.execute

atomic_method_entities.unit: one tenant-scoped journal CAS transaction, one accepted revision increment, full rollback on any failed evidence/descriptor/link/constraint
atomic_method_entities.continuation_reference_path: qualified protected continuation payload prepared before journal call -> OutboxDescriptor.payload_ref/payload_sha256 in outbox_intents; journal atomically stores these references only, no new cursor or continuation body/entity
atomic_method_entities.custody_body_transaction: existing qualified custody preparation remains separate unless a separately qualified same-connection custody interface provides atomic participation; this proposal does not claim it
atomic_method_entities.new_wait_rules: new exact scoped WaitDescriptor yields technical OPEN only; identical existing descriptor preserves state; divergent descriptor conflicts; never resets settled wait
atomic_method_entities.absent_preparation: empty wait_intents/outbox_intents may record source evidence only; no continuation/wait/progress claim. Later qualified record_wait/enqueue_outbox are explicit separate CAS preparations with recoverable source/planner lineage, never retroactive atomicity or reapplication via duplicate result
